Proposition
[Ricci flat rotationally symmetric metrics are flat]

Source: petersen:page-0139, petersen:page-0140 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-rotsym-ricci-scalar If $dr^2+\rho ^2(r)ds_{n-1}^2$ is Ricci flat, then the metric is flat. More precisely, if $n>2$, then $\rho (r)=a+r$ after reversing $r$ if necessary; if $n=2$, then $\rho $ is affine.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch4-ricci-flat-rotsym \sketch The radial Ricci eigenvalue in equation 4 forces $\ddot\rho =0$. For $n>2$, the tangential eigenvalue also forces $\dot\rho ^2=1$, so reversing $r$ if needed gives $\rho =a+r$. For $n=2$ there is no tangential equation, and $\rho =a+br$. In both cases $-\ddot\rho /\rho =0$, so every sectional curvature vanishes.

□
